questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Silent film?

options.text: It is a film without recorded synchronised dialogue, relying on images and intertitles.
It is a printed card inserted between shots to convey dialogue or narration.
It was an early inexpensive cinema venue that helped popularise motion pictures.
It is an early short documentary recording real events or everyday scenes.
options.misconception: Confuses Silent film with Actuality film

questions.explanation: It is a film without recorded synchronised dialogue, relying on images and intertitles. This is precisely what Silent film means; the alternatives describe Intertitle, Nickelodeon, Actuality film, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Silent film.
